nodes.label: AuthContext, AdminRouteGuard & Removal of Client-Side Impersonation
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: authcontext, adminrouteguard & removal of client-side impersonation
nodes.rationale: Centralizes Firebase Auth and /members/{uid} role flags in AuthContext and enforces 4-state route guarding in AdminRouteGuard. Removes switchedFromSuperAdmin in-memory role switching because firestore.rules always evaluates request.auth.uid, keeping UI privileges faithful to database security rules.
nodes.source_location: section: 3. Authentication, Role Guard, and Removal of Client-Side Impersonation & Alternative G (lines 144-155, 235-239)

nodes.label: Public Site Decluttering (Removal of isAdminMode)
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.rationale: Removes Admin ON/OFF toggles, inline edit controls, and GA moderation controls from Navbar, HomeView, EventCalendar, AboutContactViews, and GeneralAssemblyView so visitors see a clean community portal and staff access /admin via URL, account dropdown, or MemberProfileView.

nodes.label: Shell Isolation & Lazy-Loaded /admin Code Splitting
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.rationale: Uses BrowserRouter plus firebase.json catch-all SPA rewrite with lazy-loaded /admin/* (removing ~4,450 lines of admin UI and jsqr from public bundles) while avoiding separate-subdomain Auth/deployment split (Alternative A) and custom history/hash routing drawbacks (Alternative E).
nodes.source_location: section: 1. Route Topology, Shell Isolation, and Code Splitting & Alternatives A/E (lines 78-100, 199-203, 223-227)

nodes.label: Immutable Per-UID Ballots & Certify Voter Roll Mechanism
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: immutable per-uid ballots & certify voter roll mechanism
nodes.rationale: Replaces mutable embedded ballot/upvote arrays with immutable /assemblyQuestions/{id}/ballots/{uid} (omitting email/postal address) and /boardInquiries/{id}/upvotes/{uid} subcollections. Uses 3 firestore.rules get() checks against admin-certified verifiedVoteWeight (1..20) instead of a Cloud Function or self-reported weight (Alternative D).
nodes.source_location: section: General Assembly, Board Inquiries & Alternative D (lines 177-189, 194, 217-221)

nodes.label: Cloud Firestore Persistence & Default-Deny Security Rules Model
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: cloud firestore persistence & default-deny security rules model
nodes.rationale: Persists programs, campaigns, destinations, events, boardMembers, siteNotice, members, and attendance in Cloud Firestore under strict default-deny firestore.rules so edits survive reloads and sync across devices without operating a custom backend HTTP server (Alternative B) or partial localStorage persistence (Alternative C).
nodes.source_location: section: 4. Cloud Firestore Data Model and Security Rules Design & Alternatives B/C (lines 157-173, 205-215)

nodes.label: Critical User Journeys (CUJ 1-5)
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.rationale: Defines five end-to-end journeys covering clean public browsing without admin bundle download, cross-device admin publishing, mobile volunteer QR check-ins, live General Assembly moderation and voting, and /admin unauthenticated/non-staff gating.

nodes.label: Route-Scoped Firestore Domain Services & App Check Initialization
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: route-scoped firestore domain services & app check initialization
nodes.rationale: Separates onSnapshot listeners and typed writes into dedicated domain modules attached only on active routes to prevent unprivileged permission-denied errors, and initializes ReCaptchaV3Provider App Check in firebase.ts before public pledge writes.
nodes.source_location: section: 5. Domain Service Layer & App Check (lines 190-193, 317-360)

nodes.label: Staged Rollout, Emulator Rules Testing & Verification Plan
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: staged rollout, emulator rules testing & verification plan
nodes.rationale: Sequences deployment (rules & App Check config -> SPA build -> bootstrap & voter roll -> App Check enforcement) and verifies typecheck, bundle-split inspection, Firestore rules unit tests, AdminRouteGuard tests, and local emulator CUJ walkthroughs.
nodes.source_location: section: Rollout & Rollback and Verification Plan (lines 259-267, 492-514)

nodes.label: Dedicated /admin Portal and Firestore Persistence Design Doc
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: dedicated /admin portal and firestore persistence design doc
nodes.rationale: Architecture and implementation plan for isolating admin capabilities into a lazy-loaded /admin route and migrating all admin-managed and General Assembly datasets from React state and localStorage into Cloud Firestore behind firestore.rules.

nodes.label: One-Time /admin/bootstrap Without Static Seed Fallbacks
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.rationale: Public hooks distinguish loading from empty states instead of falling back to src/data/*.ts so deleted items never reappear; static datasets load dynamically only in Super-Admin /admin/bootstrap (locked via /siteConfig/bootstrap) to avoid distributing firebase-admin service-account credentials.
nodes.source_location: section: One-Time Bootstrap Without Static Fallbacks & Alternative G (lines 195, 235-239, 357-360, 422-425)

nodes.label: Shared-Origin XSS Hygiene & Dev-Gated Demo/Config Fallbacks
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.norm_label: shared-origin xss hygiene & dev-gated demo/config fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Protects shared-origin security by prohibiting dangerouslySetInnerHTML, validating admin image/event URLs with isSafeHttpUrl (https:// or http://), and gating localStorage Firebase overrides and ensureDefaultVaultSeeded demo password fallbacks to DEV/emulator mode only.

nodes.label: Two-Collection Donations Architecture (/donationPledges & /donationReports)
nodes.author: Verein Percikan Iman Team
nodes.rationale: Splits write-only public /donationPledges (locked to status Processing, CHF 1..100000, guarded by App Check) from admin-only /donationReports with atomic writeBatch promotion, capturing anonymous public transfer pledges without exposing or corrupting the verified donation ledger (Alternative F).

nodes.label: Dedicated Administration Portal (/admin/*, Lazy-Loaded)
nodes.rationale: Mounts admin routes lazily via React.lazy(AdminApp) protected by AdminRouteGuard and AdminLayout, enforcing role-gated workspaces (/admin/programs, /events, /content, /board, /donations, /members, /attendance with sub-lazy jsqr, /assembly, /bootstrap).

nodes.label: Public & Member Shell (PublicLayout)
nodes.rationale: Isolates visitor and member routes (/, /programs, /donate, /gallery, /about, /contact, /brand, /login, /member, /assembly) so public visitors download only the public entry bundle without admin workspaces, jsqr, or static seed arrays.
